append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1661). Premise re-tested on main at 60567b67e: 14 files carried focus:border-primary or focus:ring-primary as the row said, plus three bordered wrappers around a seamless Input that lit focus-within:border-primary (pwyw-picker, the shop item tag row, the listing offer field), 16 files in code and one comment. WHAT SHIPPED: every one takes the neutral halo fieldClasses already wears, token for token: focus:border-primary to focus:border-border-strong, focus:ring-primary to focus:ring-border-strong/30, focus-within:border-primary to focus-within:border-border-strong. The admin settings search went from ring-1 in primary to the primitive ring-2 halo. The two Airwaves checkboxes dropped focus:ring-primary outright: with no ring width and no forms plugin it painted nothing, and the Checkbox primitive deliberately carries no focus class. Keyboard focus is unchanged: the global :focus-visible rule in app/globals.css still paints --color-focus-ring on every control (WCAG 2.4.7); the ruling is about the pointer-focus glow. GUARD: scripts/check-field-focus.test.ts walks app/, components/ and lib/ with comments blanked and fails on any focus: or focus-within: border or ring in the primary colour; mutation-checked by restoring one site. No check counted these before, so there was no baseline to lower. check:adoption does not move.
